# Jesus Feeds Four Thousand (Matthew 15:37)

## Emotional Focus
Jesus can always provide when we feel there isn’t enough.

## Key KJV
“And they did eat, and were filled: and they took up of the broken meat that was left seven baskets full.” (Matthew 15:37)

## Gentle Retelling
Another time thousands were hungry. Jesus took seven loaves and a few fish, gave thanks, and fed everyone with baskets left over.

## Coloring Prompt
Jesus blessing baskets of bread and fish while a large crowd sits happily.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Jesus is the same powerful provider every time we need Him.”
